premise: Bird builds a nest one twig at a time; Squirrel brings moss, Woodpecker taps the branch to test it, and it holds.
inspiration: The Three Little Pigs' building motif, turned: nobody builds alone and nobody blows it down; friends help make one house strong.
lesson: A home is built with friends' help.
learning: Birds build nests from twigs, grass and moss

en-US.title: Bird Builds a Nest
en-US.text: {bird:enter} Bird {bird:pulse} needed a home for spring. {squirrel:face surprised} [curious] What's a nest made of? asked {squirrel:enter} Squirrel. Watch, said Bird. {bird:hop} He fetched a twig. Then a twig, and a twig, and a twig, woven round and round. Then a tuft of soft grass. Squirrel {squirrel:hop x2} brought a pawful of green moss to line it. {bird:face happy} {squirrel:face happy} [happily] Snug! {woodpecker:enter} Woodpecker {woodpecker:pulse} flew up to check. Is it strong? {woodpecker:live} He tapped the branch, {sfx:tap} tap, tap, tap, listened, shook off the dust… and chirped. {woodpecker:face happy} Strong as a {tree:enter} tree! And the old tree {tree:wobble 0.4} rocked it gently, like a cradle. {canvas:night 0.6 14s} [softly] That night, Bird tucked himself into his nest, {bird:hearts} round and warm, and {bird:face sleeping} sang a sleepy song for his friends.

es-ES.title: Pájaro hace un nido
es-ES.text: {bird:enter} Pájaro {bird:pulse} necesitaba una casa para la primavera. {squirrel:face surprised} [curious] ¿De qué se hace un nido?, preguntó {squirrel:enter} Ardilla. Mira, dijo Pájaro. {bird:hop} Trajo una ramita. Y otra ramita, y otra, y otra, tejidas en redondo. Luego un mechón de hierba suave. Ardilla {squirrel:hop x2} trajo un puñado de musgo verde para forrarlo. {bird:face happy} {squirrel:face happy} [happily] ¡Qué calentito! El {woodpecker:enter} pájaro carpintero {woodpecker:pulse} subió a revisarlo. ¿Será fuerte? {woodpecker:live} Dio unos golpecitos en la rama, {sfx:tap} toc, toc, toc, escuchó, se sacudió el polvo… y pió. {woodpecker:face happy} ¡Fuerte como un {tree:enter} árbol! Y el viejo árbol {tree:wobble 0.4} lo meció con cuidado, como una cuna. {canvas:night 0.6 14s} [softly] Esa noche, Pájaro se acurrucó en su nido, {bird:hearts} redondo y calentito, y {bird:face sleeping} cantó una canción de dormir para sus amigos.

tap.prompt: a woodpecker tapping three light knocks on a branch
